import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import gc
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_DART_REG"] = "1"
os.environ["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMIT_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMIT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
train_df = train_df[["comment_text", "id"] + target_cols].copy()
test_df = test_df[["comment_text", "id"]].copy()
test_df = test_df.drop_duplicates(subset=["id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

# Extract metadata features for toxicity context
print("Extracting text metadata features...")


def get_text_features(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        length = len(text)
        words = text.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        try:
            chars = [c for c in text if c.isalnum()]
            unique_chars = len(set(chars))
        except:
            chars = ""
            unique_chars = 0
        punct_count = len(re.findall(r"[^\w\s]", text))
        upper_ratio = len([c for c in text if c.isupper()]) / (len(text) + 1e-10)
        return length, word_count, unique_chars, punct_count, upper_ratio
    else:
        return 0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0


meta_train = pd.DataFrame(
    [get_text_features(t) for t in train_df["comment_text"]],
    columns=["length", "word_count", "unique_chars", "punct_count", "upper_ratio"],
)
meta_test = pd.DataFrame(
    [get_text_features(t) for t in test_df["comment_text"]],
    columns=["length", "word_count", "unique_chars", "punct_count", "upper_ratio"],
)

# Validation Split - do this FIRST before any vectorization
print("Creating validation split...")
X_train_idx, X_val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index.values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
)

# Extract text arrays AFTER split
train_texts = train_df.loc[X_train_idx, "comment_text"].values
val_texts = train_df.loc[X_val_idx, "comment_text"].values

y_train = train_df.loc[X_train_idx, target_cols].values
y_val = train_df.loc[X_val_idx, target_cols].values

# Get metadata for training and validation indices only
meta_train_full = meta_train.loc[X_train_idx].values
meta_val = meta_train.loc[X_val_idx].values

print(f"Train texts shape: {train_texts.shape}")
print(f"Val texts shape: {val_texts.shape}")
print(f"Meta train shape: {meta_train_full.shape}")
print(f"Meta val shape: {meta_val.shape}")

# TF-IDF Vectorization
print("Vectorizing text features...")
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=5, max_df=0.95
)
tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 3), max_features=2000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

X_train_word = tfidf_word.fit_transform(train_texts)
X_val_word = tfidf_word.transform(val_texts)
X_test_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_df["comment_text"].values)

X_train_char = tfidf_char.fit_transform(train_texts)
X_val_char = tfidf_char.transform(val_texts)
X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_df["comment_text"].values)

# Concatenate
print("Concatenating features...")
X_train_word_dense = X_train_word.toarray()
X_val_word_dense = X_val_word.toarray()
X_test_word_dense = X_test_word.toarray()

X_train_char_dense = X_train_char.toarray()
X_val_char_dense = X_val_char.toarray()
X_test_char_dense = X_test_char.toarray()

X_train_word_combined = np.hstack([X_train_word_dense, X_train_char_dense])
X_val_word_combined = np.hstack([X_val_word_dense, X_val_char_dense])
X_test_word_combined = np.hstack([X_test_word_dense, X_test_char_dense])

# Add metadata features - now shapes should match
X_train_final = np.hstack([X_train_word_combined, meta_train_full])
X_val_final = np.hstack([X_val_word_combined, meta_val])
X_test_final = np.hstack([X_test_word_combined, meta_test.values])

print(f"Train shape: {X_train_final.shape}")
print(f"Val shape: {X_val_final.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {X_test_final.shape}")

models = {}
valid_auc_list = []
print("Training models...")

for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    print(f"\nTraining {col}...")
    train_col = y_train[:, list(target_cols).index(col)]
    val_col = y_val[:, list(target_cols).index(col)]

    n_pos = train_col.sum()
    n_neg = (train_col == 0).sum()
    scale_weight = n_neg / (n_pos + 1e-10)

    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        metric="binary_logloss",
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=2,
        max_depth=5,
        num_leaves=31,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        n_estimators=150,
        feature_fraction=0.8,
        bagging_fraction=0.8,
        scale_pos_weight=scale_weight,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_final, train_col)
    models[col] = model

    prob_val = model.predict_proba(X_val_final)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(val_col, prob_val)
    valid_auc_list.append(auc)
    print(f"Validation AUC for {col}: {auc:.6f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(valid_auc_list)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.6f}")

print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
probs = []
for col in target_cols:
    prob_test = models[col].predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]
    probs.append(prob_test)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], **dict(zip(target_cols, probs))})
submission_df = submission_df[["id"] + target_cols]
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values(by="id").reset_index(drop=True)

submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMIT_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {submission_path}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
assert os.path.exists(submission_path), "Submission file not created!"
print("All validations passed!")
